description: Angular component for a comparison key row in a widget configuration UI, managing form controls and data binding for comparison settings.

classes.name: ComparisonKeyRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for comparison key configuration in a widget.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for value changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on component state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form controls with provided DataKey value.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on 'showValuesForComparison' value.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the DataKey model with current form values and propagates change.
